class Box<T> {
  private item: T;
  constructor(item: T) {
    this.item = item;
  }
  peek<U extends Box<number> | Box<string>>(other: U) {
    return other.item;
  }
}
class Animal {
  private sound = "...";
  private legs = 4;
  describe<T extends Dog | Cat>(pet: T) {
    return `${pet.sound} on ${pet.legs} legs`;
  }
}
class Dog extends Animal {
  bark() {
    return "woof";
  }
}
class Cat extends Animal {
  meow() {
    return "meow";
  }
}
console.log(new Box(1).peek(new Box("a")));
console.log(new Animal().describe(new Cat()));
